meta.title: Learn to code in the language you think in
meta.description: Courses: {courses}. Exercises and quizzes after every lesson, and your progress is saved in this browser with no account needed.

app.name: Learn To Code
app.tagline: Learn to code in the language you think in

footer.rights: Built for learners who think in another language.

landing.title: Learn to code in the language you think in
landing.description: Read a lesson, do the exercises, check yourself with a quiz. No account, no sign-up: your progress is stored in this browser and you can export it whenever you want.
landing.setup-description: Install the editor, run your first page, and learn the loop you will repeat for every lesson.
landing.untranslated-note: Some lessons are still shown in {source}. Translations are added over time.

course.translation-pending: This course is not fully translated into your language yet, so the remaining lessons are shown in the source language.

lesson.fallback-note: This lesson has not been translated into your language yet, so it is shown in its source language.
lesson.practice-body: Create a file with the name below inside a lessons folder in your practice folder (the one you made in the setup lesson). Type every code example from this lesson into that file, then run it with Live Server and look at the browser. To see it working, open the Source link at the top of this page and copy the page structure it shows.

tasks.title: Practice tasks
tasks.description: Do these in your editor before moving on. Tick them off as you go, they are saved with your progress.
tasks.empty: This lesson has no tasks yet.

quiz.title: Check yourself
quiz.description: Answer every question, then submit. Your score is kept in your progress.
quiz.empty: This lesson has no quiz yet.

progress.title: My progress
progress.description: Everything is stored inside this browser. Export it to a file if you want a backup or want to continue on another device.
progress.export-description: Saves a JSON file with every completed lesson, ticked task and quiz score.
progress.import-description: Load a file you exported earlier. It replaces what is stored here right now.
progress.reset-description: Deletes everything stored in this browser. Export first if you might want it back.
progress.import-error: That file could not be read. Pick the JSON file you exported from this site.
progress.reset-confirm-description: This deletes every completed lesson, task and quiz score stored in this browser.
progress.empty-description: Open a course and complete your first lesson, then come back here.
progress.storage-note: Stored locally with zustand/persist. No account, no server.
